titel: Summer Bonus: The Man with the Twisted Lip

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts; Ausschnitte dieser Sendung waren in zwei Messungen mit Stunden Abstand stumm - die Datei wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt

einzeiler: Sherlock Holmes investigates the mysterious disappearance of a wealthy gentleman in…
kurzfassung: Dr. Watson joins Sherlock Holmes to investigate the sudden disappearance of Neville St. Clair from a London opium den. Traces of blood, a missing body, and a beggar named Hugh Boone complicate the case. Holmes ultimately discovers that the wealthy gentleman and the beggar are the exact same person.
stichpunkte: Dr. Watson finds Sherlock Holmes disguised in an opium den while searching for an addict.
Holmes investigates the disappearance of Neville St. Clair, who vanished from the opium den.
St. Clair's wife saw her husband frantically waving from a second-floor window before he disappeared.
Police find St. Clair's coat in the river filled with hundreds of pennies and halfpennies.
A professional beggar named Hugh Boone is arrested as the prime suspect in the murder.
Holmes visits the prison cell and washes the beggar's face to reveal it is actually St. Clair.
St. Clair confesses he secretly worked as a beggar to earn a massive income without his family knowing.

kapitel.titel: The Case of Neville St. Clair

clips.text: A disheveled beggar sitting beside the narrator suddenly whispered a pointed instruction before instantly returning to his usual posture.

clips.hook: A coat stuffed with hundreds of coins
clips.text: The primary suspect rejected all accusations regarding Neville St. Clair's disappearance and insisted that the witness must have hallucinated.

clips.hook: A letter from a dead man
clips.text: When pressed directly by a visitor, Sherlock Holmes admitted he could not offer any reassurance about the missing man's safety.
Holmes surprised the police inspector by pulling a massive bath sponge from his luggage and demanding access to the locked prisoner.

clips.hook: Earning 700 pounds a year as a beggar
clips.text: After realizing that street begging yielded vastly more income than journalism, the former reporter abandoned his profession for the pavement.

beschreibung:
A request from a friend brings Dr. Watson to an opium den on a warm summer night, where he is surprised to run into none other than his friend Sherlock Holmes, who investigating the disappearance, and potential murder, of Mr. Neville St. Clair. Watson joins Holmes and the two make their way to St. Clair's wife in Lee, where a sleepless night gives Holmes a revelation as to St. Clair's whereabouts. This week's extended summer bonus brings another mystery with a surprising twist that only Holmes can solve, so let it help you relax and find your way into a night of soft and restorative sleep.
